findings.claim: QCOM 10-K FY2026 風險因素：美中貿易保護與實體清單等政策已經、目前並可能限制或阻止與中國客戶／供應商交易；因對中國營收集中，進一步限制或中國關稅可能對業務、營運結果、現金流造成重大損害。
findings.excerpt: Given our revenue concentration in China, if, due to actual, threatened or potential U.S. or Chinese government actions or policies: we were further limited in, or prohibited from, selling our integrated circuit products to Chinese or Chinese-affiliated customers;

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：公司持續監控關稅，影響取決於不確定的後續發展，可能衝擊需求、定價與成本，並導致呆滯庫存或準備金認列。
findings.excerpt: Changes to global trade policies may negatively impact demand, pricing and cost for our products and technologies, and contribute to the inherent uncertainties in estimating future customer demand, which may result in increased excess or obsolete inventory or reserve charges, negatively impacting our results of operations and cash flows.

findings.claim: 2026-01 美國 Section 232 公告對符合特定性能門檻的先進半導體課 25% 關稅（2026-01-15 生效），搜尋結果未點名 QCOM 產品；後續可能擴大。
findings.source: EY Tax News: US Section 232 proclamation imposes 25 percent tariff on certain semiconductors

findings.claim: Section 232 半導體 25% 關稅適用範圍為特定先進晶片（如 H200、MI325X），QCOM 未被點名
findings.source: GHY: U.S. Imposes 25% Tariff on Semiconductors Under Section 232
findings.excerpt: Imposes 25% Tariff on Semiconductors Under Section 232 Trade Update • Jan. 15, 2026 Key Points 25% ad valorem tariff on certain advanced semiconductors and derivative products takes effect January 15, 2026.

note: 搜尋未見 2026 年針對 QCOM 的實體清單／出口管制動作；2025-10 中國 SAMR 對 QCOM（Autotalks）反壟斷調查，未查到結果。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
